items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: And the Bossman is kind of a combination of Basie and Ellington and he’s playing bass.

ctx.x: He said that to me, yeah. But see Murray was, to some he was very cantankerous, argumentative you know. But he was at heart a teacher. I mean he taught at a number of schools but there were just people who he took under his wing and he was patient in his professorial and teacherly capacity. So I would go over to his place on 132nd off Lenox Avenue, which those of us who are Murrayites call the spyglass tree. That’s one of his phrases. You know you have the little spyglass, you go into a tree and you have a…
